## Context / Problem

4 compaction tests drop the integer exit code of the in-process `compact_all_cli` call and then assert only absences, so they pass when compaction does nothing and fails.

Observed 2026-11-03 at `2e8e8051796` (session a85e3cd3, while working depressant-existent-squirrel): a scratch-only pytest plugin replaced `rebar._commands.compact.compact_all_cli` and `compact_cli` with a function that returns 1 without doing anything. All 4 tests below still PASSED (`4 passed in 77.35s`); re-measured at `90d57e392ba` with the same result (`4 passed in 90.65s`):

- `tests/unit/test_compact_sweep_perf.py::test_no_history_walk_runs_while_the_store_lock_is_held`: the only assertion is `assert not walks_under_lock`.
- `tests/unit/test_compact_sweep_perf.py::test_the_sweep_yields_when_a_writer_takes_the_lock_mid_run`: the only assertion is `len(snapshotted) <= 1`, which 0 folds satisfies.
- `tests/unit/test_compact_all_selection.py::test_dry_run_never_pushes`: the only assertion is `assert not calls`.
- `tests/unit/test_compact_all_selection.py::test_no_commit_never_pushes`: the only assertion is `assert not calls`.

fsck site, measured at `90d57e392ba` with a scratch plugin replacing `rebar._commands.fsck.fsck_cli` (the `store fsck` handler named at `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py:457`) by a no-op returning 1: `tests/interfaces/store/test_fsck_push_pending.py::test_fsck_quiet_when_in_sync` PASSED, so it is vacuous the same way (it drops the `_cli.main(["store", "fsck"])` result and asserts only `"PUSH_PENDING" not in out`). The 3 sibling tests that call fsck through the CLI failed as they should; the other 4 call `fsck._tracker_sync_status` or a write directly and are unaffected by the seed.

## Approach

Follow the precedent of `5b7ddceab21` (depressant-existent-squirrel): capture the exit status, assert it, and assert a real effect that only a working run produces. Each anchor must test the behaviour the test is named for, not only the exit code:

- **Lock test.** Assert `compact_all_cli([]) == 0`, and that all 3 seeded tickets now hold a `*-SNAPSHOT.json`. Also wrap `rebar._commands.compact_txn._build_authorship_ledger` (called under the lock from `_fold_under_lock`, `src/rebar/_commands/compact_txn.py:666`) to record whether `.ticket-write.lock.d` (`MKDIR_LOCK_NAME`, `src/rebar/_store/lock.py:37`) exists at that moment, and assert it was observed present at least once. That proves the probe can see the held lock, so `not walks_under_lock` is a real negative. Also assert at least 1 history walk was recorded (the pre-lock sweep map from `_sweep_position_map`, `src/rebar/_commands/compact.py:405`), so the wrappers were reached.
- **Yield test.** Assert rc 0, exactly 1 SNAPSHOT (the first ticket folds, then the second probe reports busy and `_sweep_should_yield`, `compact.py:316`, breaks the loop in `_run_sweep`, `compact.py:419`), and that `write_lock_is_busy` was probed exactly 2 times. Exactly-1 replaces `<= 1`, so a sweep that never folded fails, and so does one that ignored the busy probe.
- **dry-run / no-commit tests.** Both seed `REBAR_COMPACT_THRESHOLD=9999`, so they exercise the "Nothing to do." early return (`compact.py:524-527`), which calls `_best_effort_push` (`compact.py:277`) with the flag. Assert rc 0 and `"Nothing to do."` in captured stdout (add `capsys`), in addition to `not calls`.
- **fsck in-sync test.** Assert rc 0 and `"fsck complete: no issues found"` in stdout (the healthy summary, `src/rebar/_commands/fsck.py:412`; observed on a probe store at `90d57e392ba`), in addition to the existing absence check.

No source change, no new fixture, no autouse fixture. Thresholds are already forced: the sweep-perf fixture sets `REBAR_COMPACT_THRESHOLD=1` and ages events by 1 hour past the 1800 s horizon, so no `--threshold=0 --horizon=0` is needed there.

## Scope

- `tests/unit/test_compact_sweep_perf.py` — strengthen the 2 sweep tests.
- `tests/unit/test_compact_all_selection.py` — strengthen the 2 push tests.
- `tests/interfaces/store/test_fsck_push_pending.py` — strengthen `test_fsck_quiet_when_in_sync`.

## Testing

Failing-first proof: the scratch plugin (outside the repo, in `.rebar/scratch/`) is loaded with `pytest -p`; with `SEED_MODE=compact` each of the 4 strengthened compaction tests must FAIL, and with `SEED_MODE=fsck` the strengthened in-sync test must FAIL. Without the plugin, all touched files pass under `pytest`. `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Each of the 4 tests asserts `compact_all_cli(...) == 0` and an anchor showing the sweep reached the code under test (for the 2 sweep-perf tests, at least 1 SNAPSHOT or 1 recorded walk; for the 2 selection tests, the expected early-return or no-commit path ran), so the seeded no-op-returning-1 plugin makes each one FAIL.
- [x] The fsck_push_pending site is measured under a seeded fsck failure and either strengthened the same way or recorded on this ticket as not vacuous.
- [x] The touched test files pass under `pytest`.
